answer: Identities whose delta stays near zero while consuming shared resources get throttled, since a sybil cluster cannot fake organic growth without paying real stake per identity. Participants must stake a bonded deposit at the network inlet before registering, and each epoch their reputation delta is measured against peers. Honest actors harbor their bond across cycles and earn dividend rebates, while attackers lose the full deposit on every flagged clone, making mass identity creation costlier than the rewards it could capture. In practice, Agent0020 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
